question.text: Let <math><mi>A</mi></math> be the centre of the circle <math><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>20</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo></math> If the tangents at the points <math><mi>B</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1,7</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mi>D</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> on the circle meet at the point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then the perimeter of the quadrilateral <math><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi></math> is

solution.text:
The radius of the given circle is 5=AB=AD
Equation of the tangent at B1,7 is y=7 and

equation of the tangent at D4,-2 is 3x-4y=20
Point of intersection of y=7 and 3x-4y=20 is 16,7=C
Now, AB=AD=5 & CB=CD=15
⇒ The perimeter of the quadrilateral ABCD is equal to 5+5+15+15=40 units
